style: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: One Piece roguelike animation sprite sheet. Crisp 16-bit pixel art, black outlines, flat clustered shading, consistent with a retro handheld fighting game. Exactly FOUR full-body poses in a single horizontal row, four equal-width cells: guard, windup, attack, hurt. All face RIGHT. Same scale and identity in every pose. Each figure entirely within its own cell, generous empty gutters. Genuine transparent alpha background. No scenery, ground, shadows, text, labels, grid, watermark, or extra characters. Wide 3:1 image. Design for reduction to four 192x192 cells. Subject:
